description: Runs AI models on this PC for the OpenMindAI Agent. Uses the graphics card through Vulkan (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) or the processor.
notes: The official llama.cpp release b11429 (v0.6.0) for Windows x64 with the Vulkan backend; it also carries the processor backends, so it runs without a graphics card too. SHA256 is the digest GitHub publishes for the release asset. Nothing is added to PATH: OpenMind starts llama-server itself, on 127.0.0.1 only, when the OpenMindAI Agent needs a model.
